description: List or search customers — by name, firstName, lastName or emailAddress — optionally only members/non-members or those created since a date. Bookeo: GET /customers.

createdSince.description: Only customers created since this time — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

pageNavigationToken.description: Token from a previous response's info.pageNavigationToken, to fetch another page. Search parameters need not be repeated.

pageNumber.description: Page to fetch (1-based). Used together with pageNavigationToken.

searchText.description: Text to search for. Omit to list all.

name: bookeo_list_customers
title: List customers
